title: Formal Property Checker
statement: Create an assertion-like module that flags when an 8-bit input violates a safety property: the value must never exceed 200 when a permit signal is low. The output should be 1 only when the violation occurs. This mimics simple formal verification properties in hardware checking.
module_signature: module formal_property_checker(input [7:0] value, input permit, output reg violation);
behavior: violation is 1 when permit is 0 and value > 200.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential state or clocks.
hint: Use a single condition that captures both permit and threshold.
